† marks proposed/target API not yet in current code.
Receiver is implicit in the lifeline.
Runtime cadence begins when JIT'd user code starts executing — ends when the trampoline returns to the caller.
Per Decision 43 the running-program substrate is split across cranelisp-primitives (user-callable) and cranelisp-intrinsics (backend-emitted-call targets shown below).
Compilation internals (typecheck, codegen) delegated to exec-flow-compilation.

IoObserver registration (extension point per bounded-contexts.md §4b + cranelisp-intrinsics io_observer rustdoc, facades/intrinsics.md retired S74 W3) happens once at session init from int when REPL/trace mode or CRANELISP_IO_TRACE=1 is active. Production batch: no observer registered, one relaxed null-check load per emit site.
ENTRY — caller invokes the trampoline with a code pointer + expected type
(code_ptr was obtained from ST[m].get(sym).code.ptr() or from a per-eval JITModule)
if non-IO (Int / Bool / String / Float / ADT / Fn / etc.) — direct call, return value
if IO inner_type — direct call to build the IO tree, then walk via run_io_trampoline
USER CODE EXECUTION — Trampoline calls JIT'd code via raw fn pointer
UserCode runs with RC, GOT, and (potentially) cross-module dispatch interleaved
layout — [total_size: u64 | rc: u64 | payload bytes...]
returns base pointer (offset 0) — payload starts at offset 16. Per src/CLAUDE.md "Heap Access".
[heap allocation needed (string literal, ADT constructor, closure capture, Vec push, etc.)]
inline atomic_rmw add 1, Ordering::Relaxed on rc field at ptr+8 —
NO runtime call. Backend emits the atomic instruction directly.
[RC inc on shared use (consuming convention — caller inc's non-last-use heap args before passing)]
inline atomic_rmw sub 1, Ordering::Release on rc field —
NO runtime call. Backend emits the atomic instruction directly.
inline Acquire fence, then call per-type drop_glue
reads total_size from ptr+0 — frees the full allocation back to the system allocator
[RC dec on scope exit (consuming convention — callee owns heap params, dec's at scope exit)]
call site emitted as global_value against __cranelisp_got_m2 + slot offset, then atomic_load, then indirect call (per Decision 23)
[cross-module call (callee resides in a different module — m2/foo)]
IO WALK — trampoline reduces the IO tree to a final value via run_io_trampoline
reduces the IO tree node-by-node, consuming each outer allocation via rc::dec_shallow_io (per Decision 29)
extension-point emit on trampoline entry — bounded-contexts.md §4b + cranelisp-intrinsics io_observer rustdoc
load value from payload — return value from this branch
dispatch the effect via direct GOT lookup per Decision 26 — NO HostContext::dispatch wrapper (see crates/cranelisp-platform HostContext rustdoc + bounded-contexts.md §5 — facade retired S71 W4).

IORuntime reads got_slot off the resolved ModuleEntry::Def for fq's DefKind::PlatformEffect entry (S66 post-rollback — GOT is the single source of truth for callable addresses), and scheduling_class from the same variant.
marshal args via CLType::from_repr (CLInt / CLString / CLBool / CLFloat / CLIO _)

platform fn body runs — may call back into runtime via HostCallbacks for alloc / alloc_with_tag ONLY (the two-pointer allocator surface, no closure-callback capability — S98 poll-in/wake-out boundary ruling, effect-concurrency.md 12.1). Callbacks installed once per session by HostContext::init at CompilerSession::new.
callback routes to cranelisp_intrinsics::heap_alloc — same allocator as user code, same RC discipline
[platform fn needs to allocate (e.g. produce a CLString result)]
continue the walk with continuation(value) — pop continuation frame from cont_stack
recursively reduce io_lhs, then call continuation_closure(lhs_result) which produces another IO node — push onto cont_stack
fork-join via rayon — each branch reduced concurrently — collect results when all branches complete
